name: lying side to side knee
description: A gentle lying rotation that sways your bent knees side to side to loosen the lower back and hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent, feet flat.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Slowly drop both knees to one side as far as is comfortable.
Bring them back to the middle and drop them to the other side.
Move at an easy pace and breathe through each rep.
